lead:
**लोकलपल्स** is a local-first इवेंट खोज और organiser platform मैंने बनाया के साथ **Next.js 15 App मार्गr**, React 18, प्रकारScript, Tailwind CSS, और shadcn/ui. मैंने बनाया it in March 2026 — it's the most recent web परियोजना in मेरे portfolio. It uses local ब्राउज़र storage as a zero-cost database backend alongside Firebase, और is built as a **Progressive Web App** के साथ offline support और an install prompt.

लोकलपल्स demonstrates a full-stack प्रकारScript application के साथ authentication (Clerk), file-based routing, PDF ticket generation, calendar export (.ics), और an admin panel — all in a modern serverless-ready architecture. Code is on [गिटहब](https://github.com/lingadevaru-hp/LocalPulse).

columns: मैंने इसका उपयोग किस लिए किया

rows.मैंने इसका उपयोग किस लिए किया: File-based routing, server और client components, layouts
घटक library built on Radix UI primitives
End-to-end type safety — typed API routes, typed React components, typed Firebase calls
Sign in, sign up, profile, password reset — managed auth so I don't roll मेरे own
Zero-cost database — no backend server required
Install prompt, mobile icons, offline-capable pages

content.content:
**Event Discovery:** मैंने बनाया search और filter by city, category, और date. विशेषताd events section. Smart recommendations using category + city + rating affinity scoring. Access-controlled event visibility: local, college, department.

**Organiser Workflow:** Organiser verification via document upload (Aadhaar, PAN, GST, business docs). स्थिति states: pending / approved / rejected. Admin review panel.

**Ticketing:** Downloadable PDF tickets named by event. Ticket history per user. Reminder toggles. Add-to-calendar export (.ics — Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar).

**Local Data Hub (/database):** Inspect all locally stored data, export backup JSON, import data on another device, clear all data. All of this runs without a server — the user's ब्राउज़र is the database.

content.title: शून्य-लागत आर्किटेक्चर मेरे लिए क्यों मायने रखता है
content.content: Using local ब्राउज़र storage as the primary database means no database hosting costs. Firebase supplements this के लिए features requiring server-side persistence. The entire platform runs at near-zero cost — important when I'm shipping personal परियोजनाs without a budget.

rows.उद्देश्य: Home / इवेंट खोज के साथ recommendations
User ticket history और PDF download
Admin control panel — organiser approval, analytics
Local Data Hub — inspect, export, import, clear

sections.title: यह मेरे काम में कैसे फिट बैठता है

content.content:
लोकलपल्स contrasts sharply के साथ मेरे [[fraud-detection|धोखाधड़ी पहचान प्रणाली]] in approach: where fraud detection used a traditional server-side stack (ASP.NET, SQL Server), लोकलपल्स embraces the modern serverless React ecoसिस्टम (Next.js App मार्गr, Clerk managed auth, Firebase, edge deployment).

The परियोजना demonstrates प्रकारScript across a full-stack application — type-safe API routes, typed React components, typed Firebase calls — rather than the JavaScript-without-types approach common in quick prototypes. It's the closest thing I have to a 'standard' full-stack web परियोजना, compared to मेरे blockchain और infrastructure work.
